name: Static map renderer: GeoJSON to SVG (with optional offline road basemap)
description: Draw points, routes, isochrones and polygons as a self-contained SVG map in Web Mercator (no tiles, no network), optionally over the roads, parks, water and coastline of a local dataset, with labels, A/B markers, scale bar, north arrow and OpenStreetMap attribution. Returns the SVG text and the GeoJSON; can also save both to the configured output folder. Also converts lon/lat to web-map pixels and back.

provenance.license_check: GitHub API license field: BSD-3-Clause, matching the actual license file

additional_licenses.role: polyline simplification in pixel space before drawing (same port as pack M021)
additional_licenses.license_check: GitHub API license field: BSD-2-Clause, matching the actual license file

provenance.metadata_source: public GitHub repository API (license field and created_at), observed this round; actual license file inspected
provenance.reference_values: px and ll inputs and their literal expectations are from upstream test/sphericalmercator.test.js. All full outputs were generated by executing pinned upstream sphericalmercator.js in Node, not this port; supplementary cases are labelled. The SVG renderer has no upstream counterpart and is covered by structural, determinism, escaping and file-safety tests.

features.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection, Feature, bare geometry or an array of Features (validated in code). Styling via properties: kind (route, isochrone, start, end, via, poi, center), name/label, stroke, stroke-width, fill, fill-opacity, marker-color, marker-symbol.

basemap.description: Dataset name (no folders), e.g. demo_kadikoy or my_pois.csv

budget.enforcement: Raw CLI byte limit and POSIX alarm; strict schema, finite values and nesting checks; MCP subprocess killed/reaped after 10 seconds. One active calculation. Not a hostile-code sandbox.

data.reads: local files by dataset name from SKILLPACK_MAP_DATA or ../map_data
data.writes: optional: <save_name>.svg and <save_name>.geojson into SKILLPACK_MAP_OUTPUT when save_name is given; never overwrites

mcp.instructions: Local offline map tool. The dataset is a file NAME inside the folder the user configured (SKILLPACK_MAP_DATA); never invent coordinates or names. Results come from the local data and code; explain them, state data limits (no live traffic) and ask the human to confirm before acting on them. Credit OpenStreetMap contributors when showing OSM-derived data. Rendering may write files only when save_name is given and the user configured SKILLPACK_MAP_OUTPUT.

limitations: A static schematic map, not a tiled web map: no satellite or aerial imagery, terrain, buildings, street view, live traffic or interactive panning. The basemap draws roads, parks/water areas and coastline from the local dataset only; open sea is not filled, so coasts appear as lines. Very large views drop footways/service roads (more than 3500 roads) and refuse SVGs above 900 kB. Labels are drawn without collision avoidance. Fit-to-view uses a fractional zoom up to 19.5. Saving writes only two new files named by save_name into SKILLPACK_MAP_OUTPUT and refuses to overwrite.
port_notes: Projection is a port of sphericalmercator v1.1.0 px and ll (256-pixel tiles), including the separate integer-zoom branch with cached per-zoom constants and Math.round, the sin clamp at plus/minus 0.9999 and the upper clamp at the world size. Polylines are simplified in pixel space with the simplify-js port from M021 (tolerance 0.7 px basemap, 0.4 px features). Fit-to-view, styling, labels, scale bar and file saving are Skillpack code; render always uses the fractional branch.
